name: Master list + detail
regions: A narrow list or inbox on the left (30-35% width, one row per object with status and age), the selected object's full detail on the right with its actions in a sticky header. No dashboard elements.
use_when: Users process items one at a time: tickets, messages, orders, candidates, requests, claims.

name: Board
regions: Columns, one per stage or owner, cards per object, horizontal scroll, a thin filter bar above, column counts and limits in the headers. No table.
use_when: Objects move through stages and the team watches the flow: deals, tasks, hiring, production orders, approvals.

name: Timeline
regions: A time axis (hours, days or weeks) across the top, one row per resource or person, blocks per event with their duration, a now marker, a side column naming the rows. Zoom and range controls in the toolbar.
use_when: Scheduling and planning: bookings, shifts, maintenance windows, campaigns, deliveries over time.

name: Canvas + inspector
regions: A large editable canvas (diagram, floor plan, flow, route, document) in the centre with a small toolbar, a left palette or layer tree, a right inspector with the selected element's properties.
use_when: The main object is spatial or composed of parts: layouts, workflows, floor plans, graphs, routes, forms being designed.

name: Map + list
regions: A map as the dominant region, a scrollable list of the mapped objects on one side (synchronised with the pins), filters above, a small detail card on pin selection.
use_when: Objects have a location: deliveries, sites, fleets, stores, incidents, field teams.

name: Dashboard
regions: A date-range control in the header, a band of KPI tiles, a row of charts, then a ranked list or table; read-only, no editing. One screen, no sidebar needed.
use_when: The user monitors and compares numbers over time: sales, traffic, performance, finance. Not for day-to-day operations on objects.

name: Spreadsheet grid
regions: A full-width dense editable grid with row numbers, a frozen first column, column filters, a summary row and bulk actions on selection. The toolbar replaces the page header.
use_when: Many rows are edited in place: inventory, prices, budgets, timesheets, plannings, imports.

name: Step flow
regions: One centred step at a time (max 720px) with a progress indicator at the top, back / next at the bottom, a side summary of what was entered so far. No navigation chrome beyond the brand and an exit.
use_when: The main task is creating or submitting something in several steps: onboarding, applications, orders, configurations, quotes.

name: Live console
regions: A full-screen stream of events, logs or alarms as the dominant region, a status strip at the top (system state, counts, time), filters and severity toggles, a pinned detail pane for the selected event.
use_when: Real-time operations: monitoring devices, pipelines, incidents, trading, dispatch.

name: Record page
regions: A page header with the object's title, status and key actions, then tabs or sections for its facets (details, history, documents, related objects), a right column with activity and related items.
use_when: The user works deeply on one object at a time: a customer, a patient, a project, a contract, a property.

name: Single document
regions: One document, editor or reader fills the whole width under a thin tab strip or top bar: no sidebar, no inspector, no side column, no cards around it. Secondary objects (other documents, files, history) are reached from the tab strip, a switcher or a menu, not shown as regions; counts and save state go in one status line.
use_when: The user writes, reads or composes one thing and wants nothing else on screen: notepads, text editors, writing apps, readers, distraction-free tools.

name: Feed + context
regions: A central stream of posts, messages or updates with a composer at the top or bottom, a left column of channels or filters, a right column with context (participants, pinned items, details).
use_when: Collaboration and discussion: reviews, support threads, team updates, community, announcements.

name: Catalog
regions: A left facet column of filters, a grid of cards or tiles (image or icon, title, two attributes, price or status), sort and grid / list toggles above, pagination or infinite scroll.
use_when: Users browse and pick among many similar items: products, assets, templates, courses, listings, candidates.

name: Game home hub
regions: A consumer home with a hero call to action for today's thing to do, then horizontally scrolling rails or stacked cards for modes, friends activity, and progress. On mobile, keep the hero full-width and add a bottom tab bar for its 3-5 main sections.
use_when: Users return to a game, quiz, learning, or social app and need a clear next action plus quick entry points to modes, streaks, and friends.

name: Session play
regions: One round or session in progress, where the question, media, exercise, or game board fills the screen. A progress, score, or timer band sits at the top, and large answer targets stay in the thumb zone with no secondary navigation.
use_when: The user is actively playing, answering, practicing, or completing a single timed task and needs one clear action at a time.

name: Player profile
regions: A person or player page with an identity header showing avatar, name, level, and title, followed by a stats band, a badges or achievements grid, and a history list. Add social actions such as follow, invite, share, or compare near the header. On mobile, collapse stats and history into compact cards and keep social actions in a sticky header.
use_when: Users view a player, learner, or community identity and need progress, achievements, history, and social actions in one place.
